source: Independent Electoral and Boundaries Commission (IEBC) - Registered Voters Per Prison for the 2022 General Election
note: Prisons are treated as a special 'PRISONS' constituency/ward (county code 049) in the IEBC voter register rather than being assigned to their actual geographic county; 'location' is left as 'Unknown - needs verification' since the source data itself does not state the physical county for each prison. 'registeredVoters' reflects the 2022 General Election register at each facility, not current inmate/staff population. One duplicate polling-station entry for KAMITI MAIN PRISON (reg. centre code 113) appears in the source with two distinct polling station codes (049292145111301 and 049292145111302), both retained here as separate records.
